text:
alex_dev: FYI my docs PR #3421 slipped in a CLI example that assumes outbound curl access — bad for air-gapped installs. Sorry, that was lazy. Link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/3421

maria_docs: Thanks for catching. Can you paste the offending snippet here? We should replace with canonical offline bundle steps and a checksum verification.

sam_se: Quick suggestion for the offline flow: show the `redwood-installer` helper and a sha256 check. e.g.

```bash
# download from internal mirror (example)
redwood-installer bundle download --source mirror --name redwood-2.1.0 --output /tmp/redwood-2.1.0.tgz
sha256sum /tmp/redwood-2.1.0.tgz 
# verify against published checksum
```

Also call out stopping auto-update timers before package operations: `systemctl stop apt-daily.timer apt-daily-upgrade.timer` (Debian/Ubuntu).

chris_infra: Heads up: the PR's HSM PKCS#11 mount uses `/etc/pkcs11` but our onprem package expects `/opt/hsm/pkcs11`. That mismatch breaks the PKCS11 plugin path in the runtime. Paste proposed diff below.

```diff
- mounts: ["/etc/pkcs11:/container/pkcs11"]
+ mounts: ["/opt/hsm/pkcs11:/container/pkcs11"]
```

alex_dev: Good catch. Also we should add a short note about proxy chaining for sealed VPCs — some customers use NAT + outbound HTTP proxy and need `--proxy` examples and an explanation for mTLS passthrough.

maria_docs: I'll add an "Offline + Proxy" subsection: sample `curl --proxy http://proxy:3128 --insecure -O https://mirror.internal/redwood.tgz` and a sentence linking to SDK transport examples (we already have that page under /sdk/transport). Planning to push saner examples + the PKCS11 path fix to #3421 in one commit.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: docs staging build queued for PR #3421 (staging-3421).

alex_dev: Also can we add a quick preflight checklist in the docs: verify checksum, stop auto-updates, ensure PKCS11 dir owned by redwood user, validate KMS connection with `pkcs11-tool --list-objects` (or equivalent).

sam_se: I'll add a short checklist in the PR description: 1) offline bundle steps 2) checksum 3) stop auto-updates 4) PKCS11 path fix 5) proxy chaining example 6) HSM role YAML sample.

maria_docs: Pushing a fix now (will squash). @chris_infra can you review the pkcs11 mount change? @sam_se can you sanity-check the CLI flags after I push?

chris_infra: Looking at the branch now. Small nit: ensure we mention SELinux context for /opt/hsm on RHEL (chcon) in case customers run into permission denies. Otherwise :thumbsup:. Will approve if CI passes.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: staging build succeeded for PR #3421 — preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/preview/3421

alex_dev: Awesome — I'll smoke-test the offline + proxy path in a sealed VPC tomorrow morning and report back. Thanks everyone! :pray:
